description:
Use only to check on an in-conversation purchase that Eventual's checkout reported as pending; the checkout calls this itself with the payment_session_id it returned. Answers active once bought or pending while the payment clears.

Premium Lock is not insurance or a financial derivative. Prices are set by Eventual's own pricing, not by the assistant. The person pays on eventualclimate.com; the assistant never charges anyone. Send only the fields a tool lists; never send conversation content or anything else about the person.

consent.description: Required to start. When finishing, optional, and it must be the consent given at the start.

affirmations.description: What the person affirmed: admitted_carrier, subscription_36_months and not_insurance, each true; their claims answer as filed_claim or no_claims; and optionally pending_changes.

filed_claim.description: Their answer to "In the last 12 months, have you filed an insurance claim on this insurance policy?", true for yes. Send this or no_claims.

no_claims.description: True when there was no claim. Send this or filed_claim.

pending_changes.description: Optional. Their answer to "Do you know of an upcoming insurance renewal offer, insurance price change, or non-renewal on this insurance policy?", true for yes.

terms_versions.description: The Terms of Service version shown for each line bought, as the quote gave it: home for a home, auto for a car, both for a bundle.

auto.description: The auto Terms of Service version shown.

home.description: The home Terms of Service version shown.

consent.title: PurchaseConsentInput

payment_session_id.description: The `session_id` the embedded checkout posted back.
payment_session_id.title: Payment Session Id
